summary: i18n fix validated. The 'security.*' namespace and 'auth.twoFactor.rememberDevice' key now resolve to translated labels in the running app. Logged in as test_refactor@fortexa.com, navigated to /settings → Mi cuenta, located the security-activity-card and confirmed all labels render in Spanish: 'Actividad y dispositivos', 'Revisa tus inicios de sesión recientes...', 'Dispositivos confiables', 'Historial de inicios', table headers ESTADO/FECHA/MÉTODO/DISPOSITIVO/UBICACIÓN/IP, badges 'Éxito'/'Fallido', method 'Contraseña' and 'Código de recuperación'. Direct fetch of /locales/es.json?v=3.7.8 also confirms 'auth.twoFactor.rememberDevice' returns 'Recordar este dispositivo por 30 días'. Verified the same security top-level key exists in all four public locale files (en, es, fr, pt). TRANSLATION_VERSION bump to 3.7.8 in /app/frontend/src/i18n/index.js is live. 2FA login screen not exercised (default user has no 2FA enabled) — verified the key resolves via fetch which is sufficient per request.
critical_code_review_comments: Locale drift risk persists: /app/frontend/src/i18n/locales/*.json and /app/frontend/public/locales/*.json are still two separate sources of truth. Recommend adding a build step (or git pre-commit hook) that copies src → public so future translation edits cannot silently miss the runtime bundle.
